subject: MAP: security evidence & DPA finalization — evaluation plan and close timeline
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@finpartner.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: security gates we need for evaluation and close

Alex — following up from last week's intro, attaching a first-draft MAP that lists the security/compliance gates we need to clear to get to a contract signature and production pilot. High-level asks: SOC 2 report (in-scope), SIG/CAIQ workbook responses, signed DPA with our standard redlines addressed, and confirmation of data retention & deletion process for their test data.

Proposed high-level timeline (please treat as a starting point):
- Week 1 (May 11–18): Exchange SIG/CAIQ + SOC 2 scoping Qs; FinPartner to confirm procurement/legal contacts.
- Weeks 2–3 (May 19–June 1): Redwood provides SOC 2 summary & SIG responses; FinPartner reviews DPA redlines.
- Week 4 (June 2–8): Finalize DPA, get signatures, start pilot.

I've attached: redwood-map-draft.pdf and a one-page SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). Can you confirm the procurement/legal owners and whether the SOC 2 needs to include our Dedicated environment?

Thanks — want to make sure we have an achievable close target (we're aiming to mark this closed in HubSpot by mid-June if the DPA can be turned quickly).

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
Attach: redwood-map-draft.pdf (MAP draft), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 scope summary)

From: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@finpartner.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Mollie Kim <mollie.kim@finpartner.com>, procurement@finpartner.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security gates we need for evaluation and close

Sergio — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Procurement here is procurement@finpartner.com; Mollie Kim (cc) is our legal lead who will handle the DPA redlines. A few clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: we need the report that covers hosted inference (not necessarily Dedicated) but it must include any relevant network segmentation and KMS usage for customer data. If you can indicate whether our test data will fall under the same scope that'd help.
- SIG/CAIQ: can you provide your completed CAIQ or at least a workbook outline so our security team can review?
- Data retention: for the pilot we require a 30-day retention window after which data is deleted unless otherwise flagged. Is that configurable on the hosted route?

We are comfortable with the high-level timeline but Mollie will confirm legal availability to turn around DPA redlines — likely 7–10 business days once we receive the doc. Attaching our procurement questionnaire for reference (procurement-q1.pdf).

Alex
Alex Dunn
Head of Integrations, FinPartner
Attach: procurement-q1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@finpartner.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security gates we need for evaluation and close

Alex/Mollie — looping in product & legal ops to own the deliverables. Action items we propose and owners: 

1) SIG/CAIQ workbook — owner: Product Security (Redwood). Deliverable: completed workbook + CAIQ spreadsheet by May 22. (attachment: sig-caix-responses.xlsx)
2) SOC 2 scope confirmation — owner: Infra Compliance (Karthik). Deliverable: one-page memo clarifying whether hosted inference footprint covers pilot data (due May 19).
3) DPA redlines — owner: Legal (Marissa). Deliverable: draft DPA with tracked changes to be shared with FinPartner; target turnaround 7–10 business days after receipt.
4) Data retention config — owner: Product Ops (Lauren). Deliverable: confirmation whether hosted retention can be set to 30 days for pilot and instructions for deletion flow.

Karthik — I will own coordination and will post items into the MAP doc in HubSpot. Sergio — suggest we aim to lock DPA execution by June 4 to keep the mid-June close.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Security (acting)
Redwood Inference
Attach: sig-caix-responses.xlsx

From: Mollie Kim <mollie.kim@finpartner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security gates we need for evaluation and close

Thanks everyone — we've reviewed the SOC 2 summary and CAIQ draft. A couple notes from Legal:

- DPA: we'll send a redline doc (mollie_dpa_comments.docx) by EOD Monday (May 25). Please confirm your point of contact for negotiation so we can loop them.
- SOC 2: we need explicit confirmation that Hosted inference encrypts KV cache at rest and that KMS keys are customer-segregated or managed in a compliant way. If you can include a short note, this will speed our review.
- Data retention: 30 days for pilot is acceptable. We will want a documented deletion flow and an SLA for deletion requests during the pilot (48 hours).

I'll also provide procurement billing contact (procurement@finpartner.com) for the SOW.

— Mollie
Mollie Kim
Senior Counsel, FinPartner
Attach: mollie_dpa_comments.docx

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Mollie Kim <mollie.kim@finpartner.com>, Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@finpartner.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: security gates we need for evaluation and close

Mollie/Alex — thanks for the notes and the DPA redlines. We've reviewed the redlines internally and Legal (Marissa) will respond with tracked changes by Thursday (June 4). Quick responses to the SOC & data questions below to keep you moving: 

- KV cache: Redwood's hosted inference pipeline encrypts KV cache at rest and in transit; KMS keys are managed per-customer in our hosted offering via our KMS integration (we will provide a short technical note).
- Deletion SLA: we can commit to a 48-hour deletion SLA for pilot data and will document the deletion flow (Lauren will own the doc).

Proposed near-term schedule: 
- Jun 2–4: Legal exchange and DPA finalization (target: signature by Jun 7 via DocuSign).
- Jun 5–8: Final security deliverables posted (SOC 2 summary, CAIQ workbook) so your security team can do final review.
- Jun 9: Pilot kickoff (assuming signatures).

I've uploaded our DPA for signature to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/some/dpa/rdw-fp-089 (placeholder link). If that timeline is tight for your legal, please flag.

Thanks — will send the technical KMS/KV note today.

— Sergio
Attach: dpa-redlines.docx

To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

I'll push the tracked DPA to DocuSign by EOD and mark the HubSpot deal as 'DPA sent for signature'. Sergio — once signed, please confirm procurement billing and we'll move to pilot onboarding.
